scope: Six tracks, three difficulties and four active race modes. Ordinary analog controls only; each accepted case physically completes five laps. Star cases collect twelve distinct stars and timed cases retain original deadlines and gate awards. Finishing and native Adventure qualification are reported separately. Different recorded controller policies, original playable characters and startup seeds are permitted. No pose, timer, pickup, lap or physics-table writes are allowed by the driving harness.
selectionPolicy: Prefer qualification, then recorded authored opening/countdown, then lower active race time.

races.testDriverPolicy: Ordinary steering selected by read-only finite-horizon force/integration predictions on private body copies; no real body writes. Prediction settings are recorded. Recorded policyProfiles adjust only test driver speed/lookahead/gains by sector. Recorded centerSections use ordinary steering toward original PMP centerline lookahead; other sections retain lane priorities and optional authored waypoint goals by sector (waypointSchedule recorded) supplied only to the test controller, no game pickup/trigger calls; fixed authored-link direction priority; original linked-road follower with its optional detour planner disabled; production obstacles and collision responses remain active. Ordinary inputs only.

Closed-loop private scalar forecasts recompute the original-road target each predicted tick, selecting lookahead/speed/lateral path offset by forward progress, path drift and collision cost; only first ordinary input is applied. Fixed authored-link direction priority (laneOrder recorded); original linked-road follower with its optional detour planner disabled; production obstacles and collision responses remain active. Ordinary inputs only.
races.startPolicy: Original authored opening camera and321 countdown. Ordinary throttle1/steer0 held until observed native green; route driver first invoked on following tick. No forced phase or timer changes.

limitations: These are composed-port full races, not original Windows full-process trajectory or framebuffer comparisons.
Full-race qualification is distinct from finishing; losing to an original opponent does not justify weakening that opponent.
This matrix does not claim all characters, all seeds, all input devices or an uninterrupted Adventure campaign.
